dry_pair_probe.scope: Four raw dry renders; gain matching is analysis-only and not a technical headroom correction or perceptual score

limitations: Technical metrics are not musical listening or composer endorsement.
Cross-family centroids use each family declared middle note and are not matched-pitch timbre rankings.
Exact full PCM hashes may differ because release fixture duration differs.
The max-Release fixture caps observed tail at six seconds and does not establish complete extended-tail settlement.
The 0.01 weak-response screen is a prioritization heuristic, not a perceptual audibility standard.
Future preset or measurement changes require hash-bound revalidation.
